description:
Key Responsibilities: 
 - Work with client management to determine report requirements 
 - Design the report data model 
 - Design, develop, and test reports using Jasper Reports or Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) 
 - Deploy & support reports in production 

 Minimum skills and qualifications: 
 - US Citizenship required. No Dual Citizens 
 - Ability to acquire a Public Trust 
 - 2 years or more of report design and development 
 - 2 years or more of writing PL-SQL queries 
 - 2 years or more of Java experience 
 - Possess excellent verbal and written communications skills 
 - Excellent organizational and time-management skills 
 - Bachelors Degree or 4 additional years experience in lieu of degree 
 
 Preferred skills and qualifications: 
 - Experience with Jasper Reports or Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) 
 - Experience with Tomcat 
 - Experience in ETL tools 

 **  Please share me your updated word copy of Resume. 

 *** I Appreciate, if you can  refer  someone who is looking for this position.
